# Action Audio

> Car detailing and window tinting in Hartford, Connecticut; car audio, remote starters, electronics replacement, and installation in Wethersfield, near Hartford. Established in 1983.

## Locations and contact
- [Hartford detailing & tinting](https://www.actionaudiostorellc.com/hartford.html): 2814 Main St, Hartford, CT 06120. Auto detailing and window tinting.
- [Wethersfield electronics](https://www.actionaudiostorellc.com/wethersfield.html): 105 Silas Deane Hwy, Wethersfield, CT 06109. Car audio, remote starters, vehicle electronics replacement and installation. Public phone: (860) 667-6330. This number belongs to Wethersfield.
- Both stores: Monday–Saturday, 9am–6pm Eastern; Sunday closed. Confirm holiday hours.

## Primary service guides
- [Interior and exterior car detailing in Hartford](https://www.actionaudiostorellc.com/auto-detailing.html): vehicle condition, interior and exterior priorities, estimate factors, and preparation.
- [Car audio and stereo installation in Wethersfield](https://www.actionaudiostorellc.com/car-audio.html): speakers, subwoofers, amplifiers, receiver fit, and factory features.
- [Car electronics installation near Hartford](https://www.actionaudiostorellc.com/electrical-installation.html): equipment compatibility, wiring, mounting, and installation planning.

## Service information
- [Car audio & stereo installation](https://www.actionaudiostorellc.com/car-audio.html): Wethersfield. Clearer vocals. Fuller bass. The songs you know, with the details you’ve been missing. Build a sound system around your vehicle and the way you listen.
- [Remote starters](https://www.actionaudiostorellc.com/remote-starters.html): Wethersfield. Start your day from your phone. Explore compatible remote starters with smartphone control, two-way confirmation, and convenient lock and unlock features.
- [Car alarms & security](https://www.actionaudiostorellc.com/car-alarms.html): Wethersfield. Bring your vehicle security up to date with two-way alarm alerts, a color-screen remote, and compatible smartphone notifications. Discuss a setup that fits your vehicle.
- [Motorcycle audio](https://www.actionaudiostorellc.com/motorcycle-audio.html): Wethersfield. Explore audio options for your motorcycle. Talk with our team about a setup suited to your bike, available space, and listening preferences.
- [Video & entertainment](https://www.actionaudiostorellc.com/video-systems.html): Wethersfield. Give passengers their own entertainment. Explore dual seatback screens, streaming-app options, and headphones for family road trips.
- [Motorsport upgrades](https://www.actionaudiostorellc.com/motorsport-upgrades.html): Wethersfield. Make your Slingshot sound as bold as it looks. Explore speakers, amplifiers, and connected audio upgrades suited to open-air motorsports.
- [Electronics replacement](https://www.actionaudiostorellc.com/electronics-replacement.html): Wethersfield. Replace an outdated stereo, worn speakers, or nonworking vehicle electronics. Explore modern touchscreen receivers and compatible replacement equipment at our Wethersfield store.
- [Auto detailing](https://www.actionaudiostorellc.com/auto-detailing.html): Hartford. Interior and exterior car detailing at our Hartford, Connecticut store. Tell us about your vehicle’s condition and the areas you would like refreshed.
- [Radio & electronics installation](https://www.actionaudiostorellc.com/electrical-installation.html): Wethersfield. Bring Apple CarPlay and Android Auto to your dashboard with a compatible touchscreen radio. Plan your receiver and electronics installation with our Wethersfield team.
- [Window tinting](https://www.actionaudiostorellc.com/window-tinting.html): Hartford. Vehicle window tinting at our Hartford store. Tell us which windows you want tinted and whether existing film needs to be removed.
- [Dash cams](https://www.actionaudiostorellc.com/dash-cams.html): Wethersfield. Explore modern dash cams from brands such as THINKWARE and BlackVue. Discuss front and rear recording, phone access, and parking-mode options for your vehicle.
- [GPS trackers](https://www.actionaudiostorellc.com/gps-trackers.html): Wethersfield. Keep your vehicle in view from your phone. Explore DroneMobile GPS tracking with location maps, geofence options, and trip information on supported plans.

## Important context
Hartford handles detailing and window tinting; Wethersfield handles electronics. Confirm the work, compatibility, price, and availability with the appropriate store. Most service images are original illustrations; the showroom images show the actual Wethersfield store. Do not treat illustrations as completed customer projects. Electronics repair is not offered; the electronics service is replacement and installation. Pricing, completion time, equipment availability, and compatibility require confirmation. Vehicle tracking requires a private code and is not public directory content.
